settings.title: A Moment of Peace – A Rare Collectors Tea From the Dilmah Family
settings.text:
Introducing Moment Of Peace: Dilmah Tea’s latest, most exclusive limited edition Ceylon Pekoe leaf tea. 70g of freshly handpicked, exclusively crafted luxury tea in a fine porcelain caddy.

Golden in colour with a lustrous, light and bright personality, Moment of Peace is floral, softly sweet and mildly fruity with a creamy texture and complex aftertaste that combine the characteristics of a superlative high grown black tea, with those of a great oolong.


This superlative Ceylon Pekoe leaf tea from Craighead Estate is true to its name, from its golden-hued liquor, to its appreciation on the nose, and the first sip that leads to a moment that produces extraordinary peace.

The best part? We’re auctioning 1 of only 10 caddies ever made to raise funds for our Plantation Workers’ Children’s Nutrition Programme. Place your bids right here to make a better tea for yourself AND humanity!
